title: Country Rock
lyrics:
(Verse 1)
Got the windows down, wind in my hair
Radio’s up, no worries, no care.
Tired of the grind, it’s been too long
Headed south where the good times belong.

That emerald coast is callin’ my name
Salt on my skin, never felt so sane.
Flip-flops waiting by the door
I ain’t lookin’ back no more.

(Chorus)
🌴 Destin, Florida, here I come
Chasin’ that fire from the southern sun.
White sandy shores and an ocean drum
Life feels right when the waves still hum.
Laughin’ with the locals, havin’ some fun
Yeah, Destin, Florida, here I come.

(Verse 2)
Bonfires glowin’ by the water’s edge
Kids makin’ castles, lovers makin’ pledges.
Jet skis racing, dolphins playin’
That beachside band keeps the music swayin’.

The boardwalk’s alive, the night’s still young
Streetlights shine and the songs are sung.
Cool breeze kissin’ my tanned-up skin
Man, I might just never leave again.

(Chorus)
🌴 Destin, Florida, here I come
Chasin’ that fire from the southern sun.
White sandy shores and an ocean drum
Life feels right when the waves still hum.
Laughin’ with the locals, havin’ some fun
Yeah, Destin, Florida, here I come.

(Bridge)
Got my heart set on a summer high
A blue horizon meets a painted sky.
All my troubles fade with the tide
In Destin, I’m feelin’ so alive!

(Breakdown)
Sweet sunshine, don’t let me down
I’m a barefoot dreamer in a beach-town sound.
Raise that drink, the night’s begun —
Destin, Florida, I’m your son!

(Final Chorus)
🌴 Destin, Florida, here I come
Where every sunset beats like a drum.
White sandy shores and the crowd hums along
Feelin’ so free, yeah, I’ve found where I belong.
From the pier to the palm trees, under that sun
Destin, Florida, here I come!

(Outro)
Yeah, Destin, I’m never done...
Turn the key — this trip’s begun.
Destin, Florida... here I come. 🌅
